name: hitaba
description: Hitaba — şahitli, veli onaylı, nikah niyetli eşleşme platformu

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n db,api,web -c gray,green,blue "npm run db" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @hitaba/api && npm run build -w @hitaba/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
